bagPolicy.summary: For non-basketball events, bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches are permitted, with screening at entry. Check the event email for any tour-specific change to the size rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Rose Quarter provides event parking and directions for the Moda Center campus; check the concert page for the specific lot and price.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Rose Quarter directions page describes rideshare access for Moda Center events on the same campus; follow the current event’s instructions for the designated pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Rose Quarter event concessions include local food options, though not every stand opens for every event. Outside food and drinks are prohibited except for medical and child needs.
allowed: Food or drink for medical or child needs
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Guest information booths offer listening devices free of charge with valid ID; ask campus staff for accessible routes and ticketed seating at your event.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Rose Quarter prohibits re-entry to its events.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are mobile only through the Rose Quarter or Trail Blazers app. The campus box office opens two hours before event start on show days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Concert doors typically open one hour before scheduled start, but the exact time varies; check the event’s Know Before You Go email. The venue is a concert setup inside Moda Center.
